title: Build the tool you need: why Theo made free SVG-to-PNG and square-image tools
summary: Theo built two free, open-source browser tools (SVG to PNG, square image generator) because existing options were slow, paywalled, or lacked basic features. His takeaway: solving your own annoying problem is the most reliable way to find products people want, as with UploadThing, Pick Thing, and his channel itself.

principles.text: Build the thing you personally need; own-use-case products tend to blow up.
principles.quote: some of the most successful things I have built have been for me wanting something so badly that I built it for my own use case and then it blew up almost immediately afterwards

principles.text: You don't need to be a visionary; having a real need is enough reason to build.
principles.quote: I'm not the one who built it because I'm some God Dev who figured it out first or some product Visionary that understands what people need better than anyone else I built this for a very simple reason I needed it

principles.text: Everyone has unique needs from their work; any suboptimal part of your life is a software opportunity, whether or not you know how to build it.
principles.quote: you have something in your life that is not optimal right now that a piece of software could make easier it might be software that you know how to write it might be software you don't know how to write what I'm telling you here is it doesn't matter do it

principles.text: Make what you want to exist and make it great; worst case you have something to talk about in interviews.
principles.quote: if you make the things that you want to exist if you make them so good that you genuinely enjoy them you will almost certainly eventually find a lot of success with that in the absolute worst case you have a great thing to nerd out about in your next interview

principles.text: Niche tools beat incumbents by removing friction and unneeded steps; local, in-browser processing means no cloud cost or paywall.
principles.quote: none of these require the cloud I can turn Wi-Fi off of my computer and it will still work exactly the same

principles.text: Even a niche audience will reward a tool that fixes a pain they share; early traction can come quickly without marketing.
principles.quote: the number of YouTubers who have already hit me up saying holy [ __ ] how has nobody made this right before thank you so much
